newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Drain rate key money market tool - Bank/Portugal.
newsitem.headline: Drain rate key money market tool - Bank/Portugal.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal sees its drain, or absorption rate, as its main money market weapon rather than the repo rate and on this basis the gap with Spain is not very great, governor Antonio de Sousa said.
De Sousa noted that the drain rate, the level at which the Bank absorbs excessive market funds, currently stood at 5.8 percent against Spain's repo rate of 5.5 percent.
"At this moment, the dominant rate is the drain rate and the difference does not seem to me to be that extraordinary against the repo rate in Spain," he told a news conference.

Some analysts have predicted that the Bank of Portugal could soon reduce its repo rate from the current 6.3 percent because of the gap with Spain where the inflation rate is similar to that of Portugal.
The Bank of Portugal last cut its rates on April 11 when it lowered the repo by 20 basis points and cut 40 basis points off the drain rate.
Deputy governor Luis Campos e Cunha added that in any case Portugal did not simply follow Spain.
"We do not follow Spain, we have an autonomous policy. I would say that it is pretty clear that we have a different stance to that of Spain," he added.
